thread:
maya: Heads up team 1 HelixCare signed off on a case study and wants us to tie it to a short benchmark narrative + a 20-min webinar demo. Target publish date: 2024-09-12, webinar week of 2024-09-16. Need interview, legal approvals, and a hero chart + 30s social clip. @sara can you draft the post?

alex: I can run the interview and capture the demo footage. Recommend a 25-min customer convo + 10-min internal edit. Who's owning logistics with Helix?

maya: Jamie Ops will coordinate with their comms lead. Jamie, can you lock in times? Also we need: 1) signed release 2) approved quote 3) allowed metrics + dataset notes 4) logo assets + brand guidelines 5) permission for short clips in social.

jamie_ops: On it. I've pinged HelixCares comms (Ava) and proposed 3 slots next Tues/Wed. I'll collect logos and brand do's/don'ts.

sara: Drafting hero narrative: "HelixCare cut inference tail-latency by 7.2x and lowered cost per 1k tokens by 38% in a production A/B over 3 weeks." Need the exact numbers CSV. Also should we show absolute p95/p99 lines or percent change?

alex: Customer shared metrics in a spreadsheet: https://drive.redwood/helix/metrics.csv (marketing-view). Theyve asked we include test conditions: baseline model, request mix, and token lengths. I'll pull the p95/p99 and attach.

natalie_legal: Two legal points: (1) We must get explicit written approval for quote wording and any numeric claims. (2) Use our consent template for webinar recordings. Please send a redlineable doc. I'll fast-track review if we get the assets today.

maya: Proposed quote options to send HelixCare (short):
- Option A: "HelixCare saw a 7.2x reduction in tail latency and 38% lower inference cost after migrating to Redwood."
- Option B (softer): "HelixCare realized significant latency and cost improvements after moving inference to Redwood."
Which should we send?

natalie_legal: Send both A and B and make clear they can request edits. We need them to initial the final quote in the consent PDF. I'll attach the template: https://legal.redwood/consent-template.pdf

jamie_ops: Sent both options to Ava at HelixCare along with the consent PDF. Asked them to confirm preferred phrasing and provide headshots/logo.

sara: For the hero chart I'm going to show: left axis p95/p99 latency (ms), right axis cost per 1k tokens ($), and a percent-change inset. Will produce two variants: raw values and normalized per A100-equivalent.

alex: After the chat I'll produce a 30s social clip + 20s quote clip and drop MP4 + transcript into #marketing-assets. Planning to record on 2024-08-28 10:00 PT. Calendar sent.

calendar-bot: Scheduled: "HelixCare case study interview" with Alex + HelixCare on 2024-08-28 10:00 PT. Meet: https://meet.redwood/helix-567

maya: Also need to route inbound demo leads from the case study: can we add UTM tags and a hidden form field to route to AE queue 'cs-helix'? Jamie, coordinate with growth for Leadflow routing.

jamie_ops: Yep, will add UTM parameters and a Rule in the CRM to tag leads from /case/helix as cs-helix, auto-assign to AE cohort.

sara: Quick reminder 1 let's avoid showing patient-level data or anything HIPAA-sensitive in the chart. I've masked sample ids and aggregated metrics.

natalie_legal: Confirmed 1 if any health-specific language appears, run it by compliance. Also once they return the signed consent and quote, ping me for a final sign-off.

maya: Great work. I'll stitch a publishing checklist: draft post, hero chart, quote approved, release signed, 30s clip, AE lead routing, and webinar RSVP page. Aiming to close all items by 2024-09-06 so we can finalize assets. :rocket:
